overview.value: A retrospective of Team Urameshi's battles throughout the Dark Tournament, featuring highlights from their most memorable matches accompanied by character songs. The special also includes two short bonus features: a group photo segment and an interview with tournament announcer Koto.

This collection of character-focused retrospectives revisits the journeys of Yusuke, Kurama, Hiei, and Kuwabara through key moments from the series. Each segment opens with a music video featuring a character song performed by the respective voice actor before highlighting that character's role and development.
The various openings and endings to the series along with some explanations to certain photos in those openings and endings.
Yu Yu Hakusho Blu-ray Box Set will contain a picture drama with a new story that takes place after the final episode of the anime adaptation of Togashi Yoshihiro's shounen manga.

An anime adaptation of "Two Shots", a one-shot chapter on Kurama and Hiei's first meeting.

An anime adaptation of “All of Nothing", the manga’s second-to-last chapter, brings the cast back together to solve a hostage crisis in the spirit world.
